transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I'm just having some issues at work. I manage a clinic, and... I guess what finally pushed me to come in is that I'll sit down to do an EPIC quality report, or go into a metrics meeting, and... my mind just drifts. 

Even when I fully intend to pay attention, within a few minutes I'll realize I'm just rereading the same numbers over and over, or that I completely missed the point of the discussion. So... yeah. I just thought I should get it checked out.
Have you experienced these kinds of difficulties with focus and concentration since you were a child, or is this a relatively recent change?

Um... I guess it's not really new. Even back in elementary school, my teachers used to write that I was... bright, but careless. And my mother usually had to sit with me while I finished my homework. I would just... lose track of my assignments, or forget to bring my books home from school. So... yeah. It's been a while.
Beyond the difficulty with focus, would you say that you have also struggled with feeling physically restless, or perhaps acting without thinking, throughout your life?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever been particularly restless. And I don't really... act without thinking. It's mostly just what I mentioned before.
